'''Weapon racks''' ({{k|b}}-{{k|r}}) are a type of [[furniture]] which can be used to create a [[barracks]] or to appease a [[noble]]'s demand or raise the [[value]] of a [[room]].

In theory, when used in a barracks designated for Individual Equipment storage, dwarves will prefer to store their weapons on the racks instead of stockpiles. Doing so in concert with [[armor stand]]s would allow you to create centralized armories for your military. Unfortunately, this doesn't work.{{bug|1445}}
[[File:Daisho-p1000661.jpg|thumb|300px|center|A samurai-related weapon rack.]]
==Bugs==
* Dwarves don't actually use weapon racks for storing anything. If you have no stockpiles anywhere that accept weapons, they'll just get left where they're dropped.{{bug|1445}}
